title: Order item (v2)
description: One synthesis order: a starting material, a target the customer names, and the intended route (one bottle per step). The runtime engine (content/rules.json) turns the player's bottle choices into real products, so wrong routes need no authoring; `traps` tag the common wrong hand-overs. target.smiles and target.highlightAtoms are filled by scripts/validate_content.py --fill from the engine, never by hand.

reactionIds.description: Toolkit reactions the intended route exercises (first = primary, for scheduling).

orderTypes.description: Defaults to [make_it]. synthesis = multi-step order built by scripts/gen_synthesis.py. predict_product (quiz: pick the product) also needs >= 3 traps.

name.description: The IUPAC (or accepted common) name the customer says first.

smiles.description: Filled by the validator from start + route.

highlightAtoms.description: Filled by the validator (changed atoms, SMILES order of target.smiles).

route.description: Intended route: one bottle per step with the conditions that step needs.

altRoutes.description: Other routes the validator checks also reach the target (graded as optimal).

traps.description: Wrong products a student plausibly hands over, with the mistake tag and the mentor's specific why. Also the distractors for the predict_product quiz.
